constructorRules: Construct each named float independently with float.fromhex or float(special), once per case; repeated references reuse the same object.
Integer decimal strings are fixed data, at most309digits here; no value is derived from TS output.
Allocate fresh []/{} for container keys; IDs only express identity, never addresses.
Cache sequence object graphs restart for each case; no global Python json NaN singleton substitutes for the declared nodes.
Records have exact storageKind/managedFile/id fields, except explicit missing-id cases; arrays/dicts remain direct Python values.

expectedSchema.observationPool: Zero-based IDs into complete JSON observation table. Only exact JSON-value equality shares IDs; no fields discarded. TreeBefore/After refer to arrays of stat-row IDs; events refer to operation tuple IDs; recordBefore/After to typed-record objects; cacheBefore/After to null or arrays of complete cache-entry IDs. Pool metadata IDs in path.metadata/os.fstat refer to complete metadata objects. Values may be shared across rows but native identities are never approximated.
expectedSchema.errorPolicy: These32 rows produce only None/TypeError/KeyError with null cause/context/errno and false suppression; exact full profile-specific message. No Unicode exception graph claimed by this supplement; S05.R retains existing Unicode graphs.
expectedSchema.typedValue: none; bool(value); int(decimal); float(hex including nan/inf/-inf); text(points); list/dict(length0). Per-case named nodes plus explicit identity/equality matrices retain object reuse. These fixed container cases are empty; cyclic/hostile JS regression separate.
expectedSchema.events: Closed operation tuples at original-method delegate boundaries; path/record access, parent resolve, lstat/metadata, symlink, regular-file predicate, cache identity, clock/get/set, descriptor open/fstat/read/close, modified-at. Read chunks retain requested length and hex, metadata lossless5tuple, expected operation sequences independently checked.
expectedSchema.expectedDerivation: Independent constructor and branch predictions in support; only native stat identity fields compare relationally. Exact bytes/mtime/outcomes/error graphs/key identity/cache insertion and retention remain checked; no generated expected values.

provenance.executable: independent resolved executable path/version/implementation/sha256 probe; compare to driver report
provenance.host: sys.platform,machine,byteorder,filesystem encoding/errors,isolated flag; no current developer machine clean-host claim
provenance.stdlib: hash every actually loaded file-backed module, code extension and split pathlib member; explicit built-in/frozen origin and executable hash anchor; independently probe required json/pathlib/os/stat/datetime/hashlib/sys/platform identities
provenance.local: Pin complete actual15-module original resume import closure and all3new helpers; unexpected local imports reject
provenance.data: Pin prepared normative JSON and exact fixture/source bytes before selecting fresh manifest base; data never evaluated or used to select executable paths

referencePolicy.remainingRequirement: Independently review/freeze full expected records; capture actual four aliases and reject mismatches before S05.I freeze. These admitted values affect local Mac semantics, unlike unrelated unsupported-host native gates.
referencePolicy.registration: Existing managed_observation_reference.test.mjs; move original four-profile loop callback body byte-for-byte into observeLegacy(executable,t), register four literal wrappers; old refusal body unchanged; append5literal domain callbacks. No new test entrypoint or matrix mutation.
referencePolicy.ownershipContinuity: Preserve existing test input hash; S05.domain.R depends S04.V (covers S04.R), S05.R and M02.V plus P00.V. Reviewer checked existing holders. Parent/digest S05 tests untouched during R; implementation later appends its own2literal callbacks to each under original S05.R dependency.

plan:
# Store path and cache domain reference

Freeze 32 additional original-Python observations: 12 managed-file type errors,
nine numeric and identity cache sequences, eight delayed hashability cases, and
three missing-ID ordering cases. Preserve explicit object reuse and differences
between supported CPython error messages. Retain every raw observation and its
provenance; any pooled representation must reconstruct the complete values.

Use the existing managed-observation test entry point. Preserve the old callback
bodies and refusal test; spell the four existing profile registrations literally
so the receipt checker can bind their identities. Append the five domain tests.
No matrix changes or reductions to earlier reference obligations are included.

The exact recipes, dependencies, file ownership, and bounded commands are in the
adjacent reference specification. All native files belong to temporary fixtures.
This reference does not activate the TypeScript Store or claim a hosted release.
